About PDFGod — Professional In-Browser PDF Editor

PDFGod is a high-performance, private, client-side web application designed to give you full control over your PDF documents directly inside any modern web browser. Unlike conventional web-based PDF editors that upload your sensitive documents, financial statements, and contracts to remote cloud servers, PDFGod processes every page, vector path, and font locally on your computer.

Whether you need to edit existing text in a contract, sign legal forms, redact confidential numbers, or rearrange pages, PDFGod delivers instant vector fidelity with zero setup and zero subscriptions.

🔒 100% Client-Side Privacy

All parsing and rendering run in local WebAssembly and JavaScript memory. Your files never leave your device.

✍️ In-Place Text Editing

Click original PDF text to convert it into editable fields with matching fonts, sizes, and colors.

🖋️ Multi-Slot Signatures

Create smooth draw signatures, type cursive names, or upload transparent PNG seals and stamps.

📊 Excel Export (.xlsx)

Convert tabular PDF documents into formatted Excel spreadsheets with preserved grid lines and cell text.

🛡️ AES-256 Encryption

Protect confidential documents with industry-standard 256-bit AES encryption and password security.

🇹🇭 Authentic Thai Typography

Full support for stacked vowels, tone marks, Windows-874 normalization, and Buddhist Era (พ.ศ.) dates.

How to Edit and Sign PDFs with PDFGod

1

Open or Drop Your PDF

Click "Choose PDF File" above or drag any PDF directly onto the browser window. The document is decoded instantaneously without any server lag.

2

Select and Edit Text

Use the "Select text" tool (shortcut E) to click any existing text block. Modify the wording, adjust the font family, size, or color, and use "Center on Page" to align headings automatically.

3

Annotate, Highlight & Redact

Highlight important clauses with the semi-transparent marker, add geometric boxes and arrows, or use blackout/whiteout redaction to permanently cover sensitive numbers before sharing.

4

Add Signatures & Approval Stamps

Open the Signature tool to draw your signature with ink thickness controls, choose an authentic cursive script, or save favorite stamps to LocalStorage for quick multi-page reuse.

5

Save, Encrypt, or Export

Press Ctrl+S to quick-save directly to your file, use "Save As..." to encrypt with AES-256 password protection, or export to Excel spreadsheets and high-resolution PNG images.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Is my document uploaded to any external server?

No. PDFGod is engineered as a zero-server client-side web application. Every PDF decoding, text rendering, and file export operation is executed exclusively within your web browser's local sandbox.

Can I use PDFGod offline without an internet connection?

Yes. You can download the single-file HTML bundle (pdfgod.html) and double-click to run it locally anytime on macOS, Windows, or Linux — even completely offline in airplane mode.

How does the PDF password encryption work?

PDFGod uses industry-standard 256-bit AES encryption via PDF-Lib. When you choose to set a document password in the Save menu, the PDF binary stream is encrypted prior to disk export so only authorized recipients with the password can open it.

Are my digital signatures securely stored?

Yes. Your signature presets and saved layout snippets are stored exclusively in your browser's private localStorage cache. They are never transmitted across the network.

What web browsers are compatible with PDFGod?

PDFGod works seamlessly across all modern evergreen browsers including Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Mozilla Firefox, Safari, and Brave on both desktop and mobile operating systems.

Privacy Policy & Advertising Disclosures

Document Privacy Commitment: We value your privacy above all else. PDFGod does not collect, inspect, store, or transmit any documents, text contents, images, or signature graphics that you open or edit in this software. All operations take place strictly within your local device memory.

Third-Party Advertising & Cookies: We use third-party advertising companies, including Google AdSense, to serve advertisements when you visit our website. Google and its advertising partners use cookies (such as the Google DoubleClick cookie) to serve relevant advertisements based on a user's prior visits to this website or other sites on the Internet.

Personalized Ads Opt-Out: Users may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You may also opt out of third-party vendor cookies for personalized advertising by visiting aboutads.info.

Local Browser Storage: PDFGod utilizes browser localStorage strictly to persist non-identifiable user preferences, such as selected layout column counts, recent signature slots, and custom layer templates. No tracking or telemetry cookies are generated by PDFGod itself.
